title: Ya Ali Kehne Pe Zaalim Ne Tamache Maare
body:
Ye Sakina Ka Bayaan Hai
ye Sakina Ki Fughaan Hai
aake Ab Dekho Chacha Jaan Mere Rukhsaare
<<MINI>>
ya Ali Kehne Pe Zaalim Ne Tamache Maare
<<DIVIDER>>
01. Chadare Sab Ki Bachane.ab Chale Aao Chacha
sab Yateemo Ko Manane.ab Chale Aao Chacha
bhuke Pyase Hee Phiraye Gaye Gham Ke Maare
<<MINI>>
ya Ali Kehne Pe Zaalim Ne Tamache Maare
<<DIVIDER>>
02. Bhai Mohtaaj E Kafan Hai.kaisa Ye Zulm Hua aur Majboor Behen Hai.kaisa Ye Zulm Hua
lutgaya Maal Sabhi Ham Hogaye Ham Bechare
<<MINI>>
ya Ali Kehne Pe Zaalim Ne Tamache Maare
<<DIVIDER>>
03.kaisa Ummat Ka Chalan Hai.kia Yehi Pursa Hai
meri Gardan Me Rasan Hai. Kia Yehi Pursa Hai
mai Sada Deti Rahi Ham Hai Madine Wale
<<MINI>>
ya Ali Kehne Pe Zaalim Ne Tamache Maare
<<DIVIDER>>
04. Koun Ab Naaz Uthaye.koun Imdaad Kare
taziyano Se Bachaye.koun Imdaad Kare
khaak Me Milgaye Sab Naaz Uthane Wale
<<MINI>>
ya Ali Kehne Pe Zaalim Ne Tamache Maare
<<DIVIDER>>
05. Saara Ghar Baar Lutaya.aye Khuda Tere Liye
shaah Ne Sar Ko Kataya. Aye Khuda Tere Liye
dasht Me Sote Hai Yasrab Ke Gharane Wale
<<MINI>>
ya Ali Kehne Pe Zaalim Ne Tamache Maare
<<DIVIDER>>
06. Koofiyo Yun Na Satao.ham Kisa Wale Hai
ham Ko Paththar Nahi Maaro.ham Kisa Wale Hai
ham Pe Barsaye Gaye Sang Bane Angaare
<<MINI>>
ya Ali Kehne Pe Zaalim Ne Tamache Maare
